newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Energy Systems stake held by Cambridge.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Energy Systems stake held by Cambridge.

text.p: A group including Cambridge Investments Limited and John Tozzi said Tuesday it holds a 9.3 percent stake in U.S. Energy Systems Inc or 360,000 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought the stake on December 6 at prices ranging from $4 to $4.125 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes, it said in the filing.
U.S. Energy Systems is an independent power producer based in West Palm Beach, Fla.
